descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S26 Existing spec: every ai.* action refuses an anonymous caller (api/actions.spec.ts, does not load on this build)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3a Speech-to-text runs through a BAA-covered, authenticated path, not a direct, unauthenticated call: routed server-side, with no API key in the browser. (UAT OAT-05 step 3; TFA-94423 AC 1)
  • T3 Every AI call, including Ask AI and Handoff, goes out from server-side Convex actions with the Bedrock guardrail applied. (TFA-92568 AC 13; TFA-92568 Eng 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Tim's api fixtures on the local stack, with no session token

When Call every ai.* action, transcription included, as an anonymous caller

Then Every call is refused before any provider is contacted

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 3 'not a direct, unauthenticated call' and TFA-92568 AC 13 (calls go out from server-side Convex actions, for signed-in callers). The Playwright assertion is the verdict. Blocked, not Fail, while the spec does not load: that is the harness, not the app.

Where it ran: local newspec-a (new Playwright specs); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-a.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-a.

UAT item: OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-05/S26

Existing spec: every ai.* action refuses an anonymous caller (api/actions.spec.ts, does not load on this build)

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-a: status passed in newspec-a/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (newspec-a/plan.json, automatable: yes): Our own api spec that does not depend on the broken ARGS registry: declaredActions() from source, valid args from ARGS plus our own entry for any action ARGS misses (voicefix.extractPatientDetails), each called with no Authorization header; every call must be refused with 'Not authenticated' (a validator refusal proves nothing and fails the case). — Deterministic, no model call can happen for an anonymous caller (requireUserId runs first).

Detail:

Our own spec (no dependency on the broken ARGS registry): 26 actions declared in convex/ai, all 26 refused for a caller with no session, every refusal 'ConvexError: Not authenticated at requireUserId (convex/lib/auth.ts) at handler (convex/lib/phi.ts)', i.e. before any provider; transcribe.transcribeAudio and transcribe.prepareSession included; voicefix.extractPatientDetails called with our own args.

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/actions.spec.ts): it calls every ai.* action anonymously through e2e/support/backend.ts on the local stack; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
